reviews.text: Excellent cat boarding facility. I highly recommend it.

Excellent boarding facility!

A professional who loves her job and is very attentive to her little guests.

Roxy, usually quite timid, let me approach her; it's the first time I've ever felt her so calm at a boarding facility.
I recommend it 100%!

I hope no poor cats were at the boarding facility last Friday when you came home in such a worrying state in the middle of the night and started banging on the door! And on top of that, you're incredibly rude when the neighbors ask you to stop making such a racket!

I hope the cats weren't at the boarding kennel on Friday when you tried to break down the door in the middle of the night, making a terrible noise! ​​Madam, please learn to manage your spending and respect the neighbors.

Hello everyone. I belatedly want to thank Cynthia for her services. She was the only one willing to take care of my cat Dali during a difficult time. Out of affection and respect, I've returned to Lyon every year since 2021, making the trip with my cat from Paris, because I trust no one but Cynthia. A huge thank you to her for her constant attention to my four-legged friend. A special thank you to her mother as well, who sometimes agreed to return my cat to me outside of regular hours because I was coming from far away. Arnaud

This is the second time I've entrusted my cat Naya to this boarding facility, and you can go there with complete confidence: your cat will be pampered and in very good hands. Being naturally anxious about leaving my cat, I left feeling completely reassured once again. Naya felt right at home and came home as if she'd simply spent a few days on vacation!

Although the owner was very accommodating and welcoming, the cattery wasn't clean :-/
The smell of dirty litter right from the entrance was really unpleasant, pervasive, and it soaked into everything.
I left my cat there twice because my usual cattery wasn't available. The second time, when dropping my cat off, I pointed out the strong smell to the owner, asking if there had been a problem, or if a cat had been sick. Apparently not. I found the same smell when I returned; my cat's basket, which was in its carrier, was full of clumping litter, and its belongings smelled of the cattery's litter.

It's a shame, but hygiene and cleanliness are paramount for me and my cat.
Excellent, our cat was very well taken care of, we highly recommend them.

I left Maddy with Cynthia for about three weeks this summer due to some renovations (and therefore quite a few unexpected things).

Maddy is a cat who was returning to boarding for the first time since being adopted from the shelter a few years earlier. She has some health issues and is extremely timid.

Cynthia was incredibly attentive and responsive with Maddy, which was a huge relief during a very stressful time.

You can trust Cynthia completely; she manages to put even the grumpiest cats at ease!
I've been regularly leaving my Charlie in Cinthia's capable hands for several years now. I 1000% recommend the boarding kennel!! Cinthia is lovely and very professional!! See you soon 😉 …
Saucisse was very well looked after during her stay with Cynthia, who took excellent care of her! Thank you! 😺 …

We've known this boarding kennel for many years. Thank you to Cynthia for her passion for our four-legged friends.

Cathy and Sylvie

We're so glad we left Cynthia with our cat for a week!

It was our first time boarding him. Our cat seems to be doing great; he settled in right away when we brought him home! We'll definitely be back!

Thank you so much!
Shqipe & Sam
A cat lover who will take good care of your pet while you're away!
